LibTmux.Query.Window

Description

Physical window fields and relationships for LibTmux.Query.

Fields describe the tmux 3.3a baseline. A physical Window can have several windowLinks; its name and pane set are shared across them. Window names use lossless TmuxText because older supported tmux releases can retain labels that are not valid UTF-8.
